Card.note: The card in its real parent: locked media frame, truncated title, description and outline tags, whole card one link. No border, no shadow.

WithMedia.note: Custom media — a flat foreground block and a muted one, both token-coloured, no remote images — at 16/9 with the label sitting in the frame.

Ratios.note: 4/3 beside 3/4: the per-card ratio holds and neither study is cropped to match the other.

SharedTitle.note: transitionName on the left card, none on the right, with the copy naming the difference. Renders identically at rest, which is correct — the morph only exists across a navigation.
